brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Kilnroom, the online shop in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: handmade and warm but not rustic or folksy; no pottery wheels, no vase or mug silhouettes, no flames. It must work on a shipping label, a tissue-paper sticker and Instagram. Web and social only; customers in Turkey and Europe.

claim.notes: No concept passed the quality gate: door and shelf got 'none' at both sketch reviews, and pair (the only one developed) failed critique in both rounds (avg 5.54, then 5.69) because it reads as 00/OD or C+donut with no ceramics cue, so nothing was finalized, exported or installed.

concepts.title: Open Door K
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 arch/doorway icon; s2 arch-in-arch portal/app icon; s3 split tombstone; s4 arch with notch, keyhole/lock-ish. All are the stock arch or door-icon family, which is the product-adjacent cliche. Try a different move: drop the arch silhouette and find a kiln-specific gesture (spy hole, stacked setters, shelf posts) or build from the K or R letterform.

concepts.title: Double O
readsAs: double zero / two ovals side by side
a pair of eyes or a toggle/infinity-like glasses shape
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 broken o beside dot, fussy, dies at 32px; s2 two rings/bubbles or degree sign; s3 squiggle/infinity-ish, illegible small; s4 big open o with small whole o in its mouth (reads 'Co', or a vessel with a piece placed in the opening). Weak board; s4 is the only one with a one-colour silhouette that survives 16px. Keep: heavy rounded terminals, the small o seated in the gap. Fix: the Co./letter-C reading is a real risk, so make the opening direction and the small o's seating read as 'two o's, one placed' (e.g. opening facing up so it reads as a bowl/cup-and-piece, or tighter gap); avoid generic Co. and keep stroke terminals distinctive. If development still reads as C plus dot, drop it.

concepts.title: Firing Load
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 coffee bean/pill/cut disc; s2 dot cluster, bubbles or a molecule; s3 play-button triangles in a ring, recycle-ish; s4 letter N. None holds a ceramics idea at 32 px; s2 dots collapse to noise at 16 px, s4 is a different letter. Try a different move: one bold, asymmetric stacked form (kiln shelf with posts, one piece offset) with at most 2-3 shapes, not scattered units.
